role: Hand-maintained Swift API reference for the Emuqu iOS app: lists types, properties and method signatures per layer (models, collection, analysis, services, storage, import/export, protocols, view models, views, constants, AI assistant, fitness/routes additions).
toplevel: Markdown only; no executable content. Code blocks are illustrative signatures, not compiled.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference
units.does: Title plus two dated notes: sleep domain types (SleepData, SleepStage, SleepStageInterval, SleepStageProvenance, SleepSegment, HRSleepQuality, SleepBoundarySource, SleepBoundaryValidation) are top-level in Models/SleepDomain.swift with HealthKitManager typealiases; every observable type is @Observable, none ObservableObject, nothing @Published; RRCollector forwards to five sub-objects; async does not imply background; errors typed from Errors.swift. Typealiases confirmed at Emuqu/Sources/Collection/HealthKitManager.swift:98-105; Errors.swift exists at Emuqu/Sources/Utilities/Errors.swift.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Collection Layer > RRCollector (Main Orchestrator)

State properties forward to sub-objects in RRCollector+Forwarders.swift. pauseOvernightStreaming returns nil only when not overnight streaming and otherwise always saves a paused session (RRCollector+PauseResume.swift:28-48).

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > Analysis Pipeline > Watch / HR-based sleep estimation

Threshold confirmed maxHR-(max-min)*0.5 with an 8 bpm minimum range (HRSleepEstimator.swift:182-190); defaults 12/120 confirmed (HealthKitManager+Sleep.swift:370-375). No WatchSleepDetector type exists.

Confirmed NonlinearAnalysis.swift:15-54 and TimeDomainAnalysis.swift:246-310.

units.does: AssistantContext (generatedAt, userProfile, today, yesterday, yesterdayDiagnostic, recent = last 14 days with ATL/CTL/TSB and cached diagnosis, baselines, 7/30-day trends, analysisSummary) with compactRender and renderLiveStateForCloud; ContextBuilder.build(...) with 14 parameters; AssistantContextSource.shared.currentContext() rebuilds on every call on a background queue with no cache. Confirmed AssistantContext.swift:18-40,132,793; ContextBuilder.swift:15-34; AssistantContextSource.swift:20-63 (serial DispatchQueue, live training load and baseline tracker captured on MainActor first, live workout/HRV overlays applied after build).

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > AI Assistant > Routing infrastructure
units.does: Routing: modes act only while Apple is selected; otherwise or in Manual every turn goes to the selected model (TurnRouter.preTierDecision). With Apple selected, voice turns go to the first consented cloud provider; Quick -> Apple; Auto -> CapabilityClassifier tier with mid tier = consented Grok then DeepSeek (Apple if neither); Deep with Apple primary -> same mid-tier cloud. failureFallback: Auto/Deep .anyAccepted, Quick .onDeviceOnly, Manual or selected cloud .none (PickedModelFailure). SmartProviderRouter singleton (Tier quick=1/auto/deep, route, daily Tier-3 cap 50, embed, in-memory counters); RoutingSessionState; TierProviderMapper.mapping. Confirmed SmartProviderRouter.swift:24-229 (cap :49), TierProviderMapper.swift:54-190 (Grok then DeepSeek :168), TurnRouter.swift:118-337.

units.key: § Emuqu — API Reference > AI Assistant > Notifications
units.does: Notification.Name.flowRecoveryArchiveChanged: posted by SessionArchive.archive(_:) and update(_:) (object = session id), by batch archiving (per merged id, then once with nil), by DataPurgeService.sweepAndForget and by ArchiveSignal.notifyChanged(); observers ArchiveSignal, TrainingMetricsCache, HeatAcclimationCache, BeatConsistencyPriorsCache, AssistantViewModel (drops its fact registry). States that SessionArchive.delete(_:) does not post (History's SessionTrash.move and discardRecoveredWorkout call ArchiveSignal.notifyChanged after deleting) and that a CloudKit-pull deletion (handleDeletedRecord) only bumps pullVersion, so observers are not told until the next archive write. Matches Archive.swift:481,509, Archive+Internal.swift:701-711,1003-1009, DataPurgeService.swift:250, CloudKitSyncManager+Pull.swift:358-383, HistoryView.swift:1057-1061, RRCollector+BackupRecovery.swift:217-223. The section also states the reference is partial and hand-maintained, that scripts/check_doc_links.sh verifies every cited file path exists, and lists coverage gaps naming WorkoutRecorder, WorkoutAnalyzer, WorkoutPDFReport, LiveDFAAnalyzer, LiveWorkoutBroker, HRRCaptureService, BarometricAltitudeProcessor, TopoElevationService, WorkoutLocationManager, IntervalController, FootPodManager, ZwiftPeripheralBroadcaster, FactCatalog, FactKey, FactValue, AppFactResolver, CompactToolRouter, VoiceConversationController, SpokenTextChunker, DataPurgeService, WatchConnectivityBridge, SettingsManager, CloudKitLiveBackupManager.
